title: About
lead:
Less noise. More you.
That's Tranquil Haven Coaching.
body:
Life doesn't always fall apart in dramatic ways. Sometimes it simply becomes noisy.

You keep moving forward, meeting expectations, caring for others, solving problems – and somewhere along the way, you lose sight of yourself.

Hi, I'm Nina, founder of Tranquil Haven Coaching – a place where women and healthcare professionals can slow down, reconnect with themselves, and move forward with greater clarity and confidence.

I'm a psychology-informed coach who supports women navigating life transitions, relationship challenges, emotional overwhelm, identity shifts, and personal growth.

I also work with healthcare professionals experiencing burnout, compassion fatigue, career transitions, and the emotional weight that often comes with caring for others.

Whether you're adapting to a new country, questioning who you are, feeling emotionally exhausted, struggling in your relationships, or standing at an important crossroads, coaching offers a space to pause, reflect, and move forward with intention.

I've experienced the kind of life changes that reshape your identity, challenge your relationships, and leave you wondering where you fit anymore. I know what it's like when the life that once felt familiar no longer does.

That's why I connect so naturally with people who find themselves in the middle of change – that uncertain space where the old version of your life no longer feels right, but the new one hasn't fully taken shape yet. When everything inside you is quietly asking for direction, but there is no clear manual for what comes next (I'm still waiting for that one too).

Many of my clients come to coaching during seasons of burnout, compassion fatigue, career change, major life transitions, or simply because something feels off – even when, from the outside, everything seems fine.

Alongside coaching, I work in the surgery department of a veterinary specialty hospital as part of a specialty surgical team caring for critically ill patients undergoing complex procedures. Being part of that environment has given me firsthand insight into the pressure, responsibility, teamwork, and emotional demands that caring professions often require. It has also deepened my understanding of physician burnout, compassion fatigue, and the challenges faced by doctors, nurses, and other healthcare professionals.

My coaching is psychology-informed and grounded in the standards and ethics of the International Coaching Federation (ICF). I won't tell you who to become or give you ready-made answers. Instead, I'll ask thoughtful questions, help you challenge limiting beliefs, and support you in reconnecting with your own strengths, values, and direction.

Every conversation is confidential, respectful, and tailored to your unique circumstances.

Sessions are held online, allowing you to join from a place where you feel safe, comfortable, and fully yourself.

Because sometimes the most important journey isn't finding the right answer – it's finding yourself again.
note: Please note: Tranquil Haven Coaching provides coaching services only and does not provide psychotherapy, counseling, or mental health treatment.
